evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal operational rule stated as settled fact — 'every' and 'completes' perform ratification without hedging or argument; the speaker presents a process that is already in force, not one being proposed.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Flat unhedged factual assertion about a past event — asserted as true and defensible, but no ratification language or operational rule lifts it to decision; the claim/decision boundary fails because nothing is being settled here, only reported.
